messages:
elena_m: Heads-up — AtlasHealth just flagged that they were charged a platform fee twice after their private -> on-prem migration renewal. They escalated to our support. 😬

sam_fin: Ugh. Do we have the invoice number or a screenshot of the lines?

elena_m: Pasted from their screenshot:```
Invoice: INV-4289 (2026-03-18)
1) Private Deployment - Platform Fee - Q2 2026 - $12,000.00
2) Support - Enterprise (prorated) - $4,200.00
3) Private Deployment - Platform Fee - Q2 2026 - $12,000.00  <-- duplicate
4) Marketplace Pass-through Surcharge - Azure - $1,500.00
Total: $29,700.00
```

jia_ops: Looking at our metering logs for AtlasHealth (acct_id: ATL-77), I see two active deployment records because the migration created a new deployment_id (DEP-9002) before the old one was closed. Our billing mapping currently charges a platform fee per active deployment id — so it doubled. That's a mapping bug.

kevin_ae: The customer is upset. Recommendation: issue an immediate credit for the duplicate platform fee ($12k) and absorb the $1.5k Azure pass-through for this first migration as a one-time goodwill. Need finance sign-off for ~$13.5k.

sam_fin: I support one-off credit. Process: finance creates credit memo, apply to INV-4289, update their balance, then send customer note. I'll create the billing ticket and route for approval.

elena_m: Thanks. Can we confirm the duplicate wasn't contractual? Contract shows one platform fee per customer not per deployment. 

jia_ops: Confirmed — SOW/contract ATL-SOW-2025-01 shows single platform fee per deployment group, not per deployment id. This is clearly an internal metering artifact.

kevin_ae: Ok. I'll notify the customer that we're issuing a credit and apologize for the noise. Please hold off on legal docs until the credit posts.

sam_fin: Created ticket BLG-4021 for this. Requesting finance lead approval for credit memo CM-998: total credit $13,500.00 (duplicate platform fee $12,000 + absorb surcharge $1,500). Assigning to @billing-bot to generate memo. :white_check_mark:

billing-bot: Ticket BLG-4021 logged. Credit memo CM-998 generated for $13,500.00, to be applied to INV-4289. Expected posting within 48 hours. Reference: CM-998.

elena_m: Great — please cc me on the customer-facing note. Also we need a short postmortem and a fix so migrations don't create billable duplicate entries.

jia_ops: I'll own the fix. Plan: add a dedupe step in the billing mapping for migration flows (detect by original_customer_id), open infra PR, and add a 1-page runbook for onprem migration checklist. ETA: PR opened by Monday.

kevin_ae: Thanks everyone. I'll send the customer update once credit posts and I have the posting confirmation.

sam_fin: Closing loop: CM-998 applied, BLG-4021 updated, finance signs off. Will post a final note here when the ledger shows zero impact to customer.

elena_m: Appreciated. :relieved:
